mapper.sql: id, game_date, fluorite_location_type, fluorite_house_number, oak_location_type, oak_house_number, is_active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM daily_resource_locations WHERE game_date = #{gameDate} AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT FROM daily_resource_locations WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY game_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_resource_locations ( game_date, fluorite_location_type, fluorite_house_number, oak_location_type, oak_house_number ) VALUES ( #{gameDate}, #{fluoriteLocationType}, #{fluoriteHouseNumber}, #{oakLocationType}, #{oakHouseNumber} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fluorite_location_type = new.fluorite_location_type, fluorite_house_number = new.fluorite_house_number, oak_location_type = new.oak_location_type, oak_house_number = new.oak_house_number, is_active = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: UPDATE daily_resource_locations SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
